test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

I am sure / that he will praying / for a good crop / this year.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the fourth part of the given sentence, the verb form 'will praying' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the correct form should be **'will be praying'** to indicate future continuous tense.
 
• The future continuous tense is used to describe actions that will be happening at a specific moment in the future.
 
 
• **Example:** *She **will be traveling** to London next week*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct form is 'will be praying'.

Hence, the correct sentence is: ***I am sure that he will be praying__ for a good crop this year*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The future continuous tense is used to indicate that an action will be in progress at a specific time in the future.
 
 
• **Example:** *At this time tomorrow, I **will be working** on my project*.
 
 
 
• It is formed using the structure: ***will be + present participle (verb + ing)***.
 
 
• Example: *They **will be attending** the meeting next week.*
